title: Second moment of a sign decomposition
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $d$ and $e$ be real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose that for every sign $b$ and every point $x$ of the $n$-dimensional cube, $f(b,x)=b\,d(x)+e(x)$. Then $\mathbb{E}[f^2]=\mathbb{E}[d^2]+\mathbb{E}[e^2]$, where each expectation is uniform over the cube on which its function is defined.
